summary: Split run_tagging's per-chunk work into a pure prepare+call+parse function returning a result object, with every DB write moved behind a single writer — byte-identical behaviour at one worker, so concurrency lands on a seam that already exists

resolution.note: tag_one_chunk() (pure, no sqlite) + apply_chunk_result() (single writer) split from run_tagging's serial loop; behaviour-identical, 9 new tests in tests/test_tag_concepts_pure.py, full suite green (627 passed)
